about: The apps the management page offers: each a repository URL and a commit id (their released tags), cloned by hash by the git app in the skein. The git app comes first: a skein from the default image carries its tree (apps/git) and installs it from there.

apps.name: git
apps.description: Clones one commit of a git repository into the skein, by hash, and builds its app record: how this page installs the rest.

apps.name: shell
apps.description: The shell over a tree: brush, coreutils, the toolset, python's stdlib. Box run.

apps.name: chat
apps.description: The chat loop: turns with an inference peer, its bash calls in the shell app. Box chat; needs the shell app.

apps.name: chain
apps.description: Chain state: headers, transactions, proofs; ingests BEEF and broadcasts.

apps.name: overlay
apps.description: The overlay engine: BRC-22 submit and BRC-24 lookup over topic managers. Needs the chain app.

apps.name: onboard
apps.description: Creates skeins for others through the host's instance manager. Only works in a host skein.
